  - Make a real impact in healthcare - help make healthcare more accessible to everyone
  - Own meaningful enterprise deals - take increasing ownership of large, complex opportunities with hospitals and health systems
  - Have a seat at the table - work directly with the founders and influence GTM, product, and company strategy
  - Build from the ground up - help shape the sales processes, systems, and team that future GTM hires will inherit
